answer: A farm that opens challenges speculatively across many aliases hence burns capital on every one it does not finish. Because the juniper deposit is held in the anchor escrow, the ledge audit records each forfeiture and the cost of a failed attempt is fixed rather than optional. Opening a challenge costs a deposit of 9 units that is returned only on a graded submission, so abandoning an attempt is a real loss. That is 17 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
